speakers.name: Michael Wooldridge
speakers.bio: Author of textbooks that shaped the multi-agent systems field. On what classical MAS research already knows about measuring collective behavior.

speakers.name: Samy Bengio
speakers.bio: How capability scales as AI systems grow more composite.

speakers.name: Mikaela Grace
speakers.bio: How deployed agents coordinate in practice, and where coordination breaks.

speakers.name: Bo An
speakers.bio: Game-theoretic and reinforcement-learning approaches to multi-agent decision making.

speakers.name: Joel Z. Leibo
speakers.bio: What Melting Pot and Concordia reveal about multi-agent cooperation, and what they still miss.

speakers.name: Noah Goodman
speakers.bio: The cognitive-science view of collective reasoning.

organizers.name: Raphael Shu
organizers.bio: Principal Scientist working on AI agents. PhD, University of Tokyo (2020). Led Dialog2API and agentic capability development for the Titan LLM at AWS. ACL 2017 Outstanding Paper Award. Chaired WMAC 2025 and 2026.

organizers.name: Alborz Geramifard
organizers.bio: Distinguished Scientist working on agentic reinforcement learning. Previously led Conversational AI teams at Meta and Amazon. PhD, MIT. Has organized more than ten workshops and summits; Area Chair for ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, and RLC.

organizers.name: Alex Marin
organizers.bio: Lead Applied Scientist, previously Principal Applied Scientist at Microsoft. PhD, University of Washington, where he is Affiliate Professor in Linguistics. Workshop Chair for EMNLP and Program Chair for WeCNLP.

organizers.name: Yusen Zhang
organizers.bio: Postdoctoral Research Scientist working on LLM agents and multi-agent systems. Co-chaired WMAC 2026. SAC Award at NAACL 2025; Best Workshop Paper at AAAI 2025.

organizers.name: Asli Celikyilmaz
organizers.bio: Agentic AI Research Director and Affiliate Faculty. Research on multi-agent societies and optimization that balances individual agent objectives against collaborative outcomes. IEEE Fellow; Editor-in-Chief of TACL.
